d:
Vishnugupt pratyek shishy men alakshendr ke prati vidroh hetu josh bhar rahe hain. vo apne shishyon se avhan karte hain ki vo soe hue samaj ko jagrat karen. vahin chandragupt apne sakha akshay aur senapti ke sath apne kartavy path par nikal para hai. aage kya hota hai dekhie iss bhag men.
Each disciple of Vishnugupt is filled with rebellion against Alexander. They motivate their disciples to awaken the dormant society. Meanwhile, Chandragupt has embarked on his duty path with his friend Akshay and the army chief. What happens next? Let's see in this episode
